name: Line Chart
description: Data has a time axis; user needs to observe rise/fall trends or rate of change over a continuous period
data_requirements: <1000 pts: SVG; ≥1000 pts: Canvas + downsampling; >10000: aggregate to intervals
keywords: trend, time-series, line, growth, timeline, progress
when_not_to_use: Fewer than 4 data points (use stat card); more than 6 series (visual noise); no time dimension exists
color_guidance: Primary: #0080FF. Multiple series: distinct colors + distinct line styles. Fill: 20% opacity
accessibility_notes: Differentiate series by line style (solid/dashed/dotted) not color alone. Add pattern overlays for colorblind users.
a11y_fallback: Dashed/dotted lines per series; togglable data table with timestamps and values

name: Bar Chart (Horizontal or Vertical)
description: Comparing discrete categories by magnitude; ranking or ordering is the core insight; categories ≤ 15
data_requirements: <20 categories: vertical bar; 20–50: horizontal bar; >50: paginated table
keywords: compare, categories, bar, comparison, ranking
when_not_to_use: Categories > 15 (use table or search); data has time dimension (use line); showing proportions (use waffle/stacked)
color_guidance: Each bar: distinct color. Grouped: same hue family. Always sort descending by value
accessibility_notes: Value labels on each bar by default. Sort control for user reordering.
a11y_fallback: Value labels always visible; provide CSV export

name: Pie Chart or Donut
description: ≤5 categories; one dominant segment vs rest; emphasis on visual proportion over exact values
data_requirements: Max 6 slices; beyond that switch to stacked bar 100%
keywords: part-to-whole, pie, donut, percentage, proportion, share
when_not_to_use: Categories > 5; slice differences < 5% (visually indistinguishable); user needs precise values; accessibility-first context
color_guidance: 5–6 max colors. Contrasting palette. Largest slice at 12 o'clock. Always label slices with %
accessibility_notes: Pie charts fail WCAG for colorblind users. Slices rely on color alone. Avoid as primary chart in a11y contexts.
a11y_fallback: Must provide stacked bar alternative + percentage data table as mandatory fallback

name: Scatter Plot or Bubble Chart
description: Exploring relationship between two continuous variables; identifying clusters or outliers in a dataset
data_requirements: <500 pts: SVG; 500–5000: Canvas at 0.6–0.8 opacity; >5000: hexbin or aggregate first
keywords: correlation, distribution, scatter, relationship, pattern, cluster
when_not_to_use: Variables are categorical (use grouped bar); fewer than 20 points (patterns aren't meaningful); mobile-primary context
color_guidance: Color axis: gradient (blue → red). Bubble size: relative to 3rd variable. Opacity: 0.6–0.8 to show density
accessibility_notes: Provide data table alternative. Combine color + shape distinction for colorblind users.
a11y_fallback: Data table with correlation coefficient annotation; shape markers (circle/square/triangle) per group

name: Heat Map or Choropleth
description: Showing intensity/density across a 2D grid; time-based patterns (e.g., activity by hour × day)
data_requirements: Up to 10,000 cells efficiently; beyond that aggregate; calendar heatmap: 365 cells max per SVG
keywords: heatmap, heat-map, intensity, density, matrix, calendar
when_not_to_use: Fewer than 20 cells (use bar); user needs to read exact values; colorblind users without pattern fallback
color_guidance: Gradient: Cool (blue) to Hot (red). Divergent scale for ±data. Always include numeric color legend
accessibility_notes: Pattern overlay for colorblind users. Numerical value on hover. Legend must include scale ticks.
a11y_fallback: Numerical overlay on hover; downloadable grid table with row/column labels

name: Choropleth Map or Bubble Map
description: Data has a regional/location dimension; spatial distribution is the core insight for the user
data_requirements: <1000 regions: SVG; ≥1000: Canvas/WebGL (Deck.gl); global maps: tile-based rendering
keywords: geographic, map, location, region, geo, spatial, choropleth
when_not_to_use: Regions have very different sizes making visual comparison misleading (use bar); mobile-primary context
color_guidance: Single color gradient per region group. Categorized colors for discrete types. Legend with clear scale breaks
accessibility_notes: Include text labels for major regions. Provide keyboard navigation between regions.
a11y_fallback: Region text labels; sortable data table by region name and value; keyboard-navigable regions

name: Funnel Chart or Sankey
description: Sequential multi-stage process; showing conversion or drop-off rates between defined stages
data_requirements: 3–8 stages optimal; beyond 8 stages group minor steps into 'Other'
keywords: funnel, flow, conversion, drop-off, pipeline, stages
when_not_to_use: Stages aren't sequential; values don't decrease monotonically (use bar); fewer than 3 stages
color_guidance: Stages: single color gradient (start → end). Show conversion % between each stage. Highlight biggest drop
accessibility_notes: Explicit conversion % as text per stage. Stage labels always visible. Linear list view as fallback.
a11y_fallback: Provide linear list view with stage name + count + drop-off %; keyboard traversal

name: Gauge Chart or Bullet Chart
description: Single KPI measured against a defined target or threshold; dashboard summary context
data_requirements: Single metric per gauge; for 3+ KPIs use bullet chart grid layout
keywords: performance, target, kpi, gauge, goal, threshold, progress
when_not_to_use: No target or benchmark exists; comparing multiple KPIs at once (use bullet chart grid)
color_guidance: Performance: Red → Yellow → Green gradient. Target: marker line. Threshold zones clearly differentiated
accessibility_notes: Always show numerical value + % of target as text beside chart. Never rely on color position alone.
a11y_fallback: Numerical value + % of target shown as visible text; ARIA live region for real-time updates

name: Line with Confidence Band
description: Historical data + model predictions; communicating uncertainty range to non-technical stakeholders
data_requirements: Keep historical window to 30–90 days for readability; forecast horizon ≤ 30% of visible x-axis range
keywords: forecast, prediction, confidence, band, projection, estimate
when_not_to_use: No historical baseline; prediction confidence is too low to be useful; audience is not data-literate
color_guidance: Actual: solid line #0080FF. Forecast: dashed #FF9500. Confidence band: 15% opacity fill same hue
accessibility_notes: Toggle between actual-only and forecast views. Legend must distinguish lines beyond color (solid vs dashed).
a11y_fallback: Toggle actual/forecast independently; legend labels must include line-style description

name: Line Chart with Highlights
description: Monitoring a time-series for outliers; alerting users to unexpected spikes or dips in operational data
data_requirements: Stream at ≤60fps with Canvas; batch: up to 10,000 pts; mark anomalies as a separate data layer
keywords: anomaly, outlier, spike, alert, detection, monitoring, deviation
when_not_to_use: Anomalies are predefined categories (use bar with highlight); real-time context without a pause control
color_guidance: Normal: #0080FF solid line. Anomaly marker: #FF0000 circle + filled. Alert band: #FFF3CD background zone
accessibility_notes: Use shape marker (not color only) for anomaly points. Add text annotation per anomaly event.
a11y_fallback: Text alert annotation per anomaly; anomaly summary list panel alongside chart

name: Treemap
description: Showing size relationships within a hierarchy; overview of proportional structure (e.g., budget breakdown)
data_requirements: <200 nodes: SVG; 200–1000: Canvas; >1000: paginate or pre-filter before rendering
keywords: hierarchy, nested, treemap, parent, children, breakdown, drill
when_not_to_use: Hierarchy depth > 3 levels (too complex to read); user needs to compare sibling values precisely
color_guidance: Parent nodes: distinct hues. Children: lighter shades of same hue. White separator borders: 2–3px
accessibility_notes: Poor baseline accessibility. Always provide table alternative as primary view. Label all large areas.
a11y_fallback: Collapsible tree table as primary view; treemap as supplementary visual only

name: Sankey Diagram
description: Showing how quantities flow between nodes; multi-source multi-target distribution
data_requirements: <50 flows: SVG; ≥50: Canvas; >200 flows: aggregate minor flows into 'Other' node
keywords: flow, process, sankey, distribution, source, target, transfer
when_not_to_use: Flow directions form loops (use network graph); fewer than 3 source-target pairs; mobile-primary context
color_guidance: Gradient from source to target color. Flow opacity: 0.4–0.6. Node labels always visible
accessibility_notes: Structural flow charts cannot be conveyed by color alone. Provide flow table. Avoid on mobile.
a11y_fallback: Flow table (Source → Target → Value); keyboard-traversable node list with tab stops

name: Waterfall Chart
description: Showing how individual positive/negative components add up to a final total (e.g., P&L, budget variance)
data_requirements: 4–12 bars optimal; beyond 12 aggregate minor items into a single 'Other' bar
keywords: waterfall, cumulative, variance, incremental, bridge, delta
when_not_to_use: Changes are not additive; more than 12 bars (readability breaks); audience expects a simple total
color_guidance: Increases: #4CAF50. Decreases: #F44336. Start total: #2196F3. End total: #0D47A1. Running total line: dashed
accessibility_notes: Color + directional arrow icon per bar (not color alone). Labels on every bar.
a11y_fallback: Table with running total column; directional arrow icons per row

name: Radar / Spider Chart
description: Comparing multiple entities across the same fixed set of attributes (e.g., product feature comparison)
data_requirements: 2–3 datasets maximum per chart; 5–8 axes; beyond 8 axes switch to parallel coordinates
keywords: radar, spider, multi-variable, attributes, dimensions, comparison
when_not_to_use: Axes > 8 (unreadable); values need precise comparison (use grouped bar); audience unfamiliar with radar charts
color_guidance: Single dataset: #0080FF at 20% fill. Multiple: distinct hues with 30% fill. Border: full opacity
accessibility_notes: Limit axes to 5–8. Always provide grouped bar chart alternative for precise reading.
a11y_fallback: Grouped bar chart as mandatory alternative; include raw data table

name: Candlestick Chart
description: Financial time-series with Open/High/Low/Close data; trading or investment product context only
data_requirements: Real-time: Canvas required. Historical: paginate by time range. Max 500 candles visible at once
keywords: stock, trading, ohlc, candlestick, finance, price, volume
when_not_to_use: Non-financial audience; no OHLC data available (use line chart); accessibility-first context
color_guidance: Bullish: #26A69A. Bearish: #EF5350. Volume bars: 40% opacity below. Body fill vs hollow for OHLC style
accessibility_notes: Provide OHLC data table. Colorblind: use fill vs outline pattern (bullish = filled, bearish = hollow).
a11y_fallback: OHLC data table with sortable columns; numeric summary panel (daily change %)

name: Network Graph
description: Mapping connections between entities; network topology or social graph exploration context
data_requirements: ≤100 nodes: SVG; 101–500: Canvas; >500: must apply clustering/LOD before rendering
keywords: network, graph, nodes, edges, connections, relationships, force
when_not_to_use: Node count > 500 without clustering pre-applied; user needs precise connection counts; mobile context
color_guidance: Node types: categorical colors. Edges: #90A4AE at 60% opacity. Highlight path: #F59E0B
accessibility_notes: Fundamentally inaccessible without alternative. Never use as sole representation. Always provide list alternative.
a11y_fallback: Adjacency list table (Node A → Node B → Weight); hierarchical tree view when structure allows

name: Box Plot
description: Showing spread, median, and outliers of a dataset; comparing distributions across multiple groups
data_requirements: Any sample size; aggregated representation so rendering is ⚡ Excellent at any volume
keywords: distribution, statistical, spread, median, outlier, quartile, boxplot
when_not_to_use: Fewer than 20 data points per group (distribution is not meaningful); audience unfamiliar with statistical charts
color_guidance: Box fill: #BBDEFB. Border: #1976D2. Median line: #D32F2F bold. Outlier dots: #F44336
accessibility_notes: Include stats summary table. Annotate outlier count in chart subtitle.
a11y_fallback: Stats summary table (min / Q1 / median / Q3 / max / mean); outlier count annotation

name: Bullet Chart
description: Dashboard with multiple KPIs side by side; space-constrained contexts where a gauge is too large
data_requirements: Ideal for 3–10 bullet charts in a grid; scales to any count efficiently
keywords: bullet, compact, kpi, dashboard, target, benchmark, range
when_not_to_use: Single KPI with emphasis (use gauge); data has no defined target range; fewer than 3 KPIs
color_guidance: Qualitative ranges: #FFCDD2 / #FFF9C4 / #C8E6C9 (bad/ok/good). Performance bar: #1976D2. Target: black 3px marker
accessibility_notes: All values always visible as text. Color ranges are labeled with text thresholds not color alone.
a11y_fallback: Numerical values always visible (not hover-only); color ranges labeled with threshold text

name: Waffle Chart
description: Showing what fraction of a whole is filled; percentage progress in a visually engaging and accessible format
data_requirements: 10×10 grid standard (100 cells); for > 5 categories switch to stacked 100% bar
keywords: waffle, percentage, proportion, progress, filled, grid
when_not_to_use: More than 5 categories (use stacked bar); exact values matter over visual proportion; very tight space
color_guidance: 3–5 categories max. 2–3px gap between cells. Each category a distinct accessible color pair
accessibility_notes: Better than pie for accessibility. Percentage text label always visible. Each cell has aria-label.
a11y_fallback: Percentage text always visible; grid cells labeled with aria-label value; provide legend

name: Sunburst Chart
description: Exploring nested proportions where both hierarchy and relative size matter (e.g., org spend breakdown)
data_requirements: <100 nodes: SVG; 100–500: Canvas; >500: filter to top N before rendering
keywords: sunburst, hierarchy, nested, proportion, radial, circle
when_not_to_use: More than 3 hierarchy levels (outer rings become unreadable); precision matters over overview; mobile
color_guidance: Center to outer: darker to lighter hue. Each level 15–20% lighter. Contrasting border between sectors
accessibility_notes: Poor accessibility beyond 2 levels. Mandatory table alternative required for any production use.
a11y_fallback: Collapsible indented list with percentages; breadcrumb trail for current drill-down state

name: Decomposition Tree
description: Decomposing a metric into contributing factors; AI-assisted analysis or BI drill-down scenarios
data_requirements: Up to 5 levels deep; limit visible nodes to 20 per level for readability; lazy-load deeper levels
keywords: root cause, decomposition, tree, hierarchy, drill-down, ai-split, attribution
when_not_to_use: No clear parent-child causal relationship; audience expects a summary rather than exploration
color_guidance: Positive impact nodes: #2563EB. Negative impact nodes: #EF4444. Neutral connectors: #94A3B8
accessibility_notes: Keyboard-navigable expand/collapse. Screen reader announces node value and % contribution.
a11y_fallback: Keyboard expand/collapse tree; screen reader announces node label + value + % impact

name: 3D Scatter / Surface Plot
description: Scientific/engineering context where Z-axis carries essential info not expressible in 2D
data_requirements: WebGL required. Deck.gl: up to 1M points. Three.js: LOD required beyond 50,000 pts
keywords: 3d, spatial, immersive, terrain, molecular, volumetric, point-cloud
when_not_to_use: 2D projection conveys the same insight; mobile context; accessibility-required environments; standard business dashboards
color_guidance: Depth cues: lighting and shading. Z-axis: color gradient (cool → warm). Transparent overlapping: opacity 0.4
accessibility_notes: 3D spatial charts are fundamentally inaccessible. Must not be used as primary chart type in any product UI.
a11y_fallback: Mandatory 2D projection view + data table; do not use as primary chart type in product UI

name: Streaming Area Chart
description: Live monitoring dashboards; IoT/ops data updating at ≥1 Hz; user needs current value at a glance
data_requirements: Canvas/WebGL required. Buffer last 60–300s of data. Downsample older data on scroll
keywords: streaming, real-time, ticker, live, velocity, pulse, monitoring
when_not_to_use: Update frequency < 1/min (use periodic-refresh line chart); flashing content without reduced-motion support
color_guidance: Current pulse: #00FF00 (dark theme) or #0080FF (light theme). History: fading opacity. Grid: dark background
accessibility_notes: Pause/resume control required. Current value as large visible text KPI. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
a11y_fallback: Pause/resume button required; current value shown as large text KPI; prefers-reduced-motion: freeze animation

name: Word Cloud with Sentiment
description: NLP output visualization; exploratory analysis of text corpus sentiment; frequency-weighted keyword overview
data_requirements: 50–5000 terms optimal. Beyond 5000: apply top-N filtering before render. Avoid on mobile
keywords: sentiment, emotion, nlp, opinion, feeling, text-analysis
when_not_to_use: Precise values matter (word size is inherently imprecise); screen-reader context; corpus < 50 items
color_guidance: Positive: #22C55E. Negative: #EF4444. Neutral: #94A3B8. Word size maps to frequency
accessibility_notes: Word clouds fail screen readers. Never use as sole output of NLP analysis. Always pair with list view.
a11y_fallback: Sortable list view by frequency with sentiment label column; word cloud as supplementary only

name: Process Map / Graph
description: Analyzing event logs to visualize actual process flows; identifying bottlenecks and deviations in ops/product funnels
data_requirements: <30 nodes: SVG; 30–100: Canvas; >100: apply variant filtering (top 80% of cases) before rendering
keywords: process, mining, variants, path, bottleneck, log, event
when_not_to_use: No event log data available; audience expects a static flowchart (use diagram tool); node count > 100 without pre-filtering
color_guidance: Happy path: #10B981 thick line. Deviations: #F59E0B thin line. Bottleneck nodes: #EF4444 fill
accessibility_notes: Complex graphs are hard to navigate. Provide path summary text. Highlight top 3 bottlenecks as annotations.
a11y_fallback: Path summary table (variant → frequency → avg duration); top 3 bottlenecks as text annotation panel
